Graduate Programs
The Graduate School oversees all facets of Temple University’s graduate programs within all its schools and colleges. It is responsible for supporting graduate students, faculty and staff to ensure that all schools and colleges can meet standards of scholarship and advance educational programs.
As a college in and of itself, the Graduate School offers a home to interdisciplinary graduate degrees and certificate programs. Temple University considers interdisciplinary education critical to the university's mission of opportunity, engagement and discovery.
When choosing a path for graduate education, multifaceted interests can be fulfilled by engaging in scholarship that spans disciplines. An interdisciplinary program gives students the opportunity to engage with multiple complimentary areas of study. Interdisciplinary scholars graduating from these programs will have the expertise needed for inventive problem-solving that initiates change and leads to universal progress.
